EventSettings.title: EventSettings
EventSettings.description: Global yearbook invitation metadata, default time, venue, dress code, custom invitation photo URLs, and day schedule configured by the admin.

eventTitle.description: Main title of the yearbook ceremony.

classLabel.description: Class, cohort, or developer handle displayed on the invitation.

defaultTime.description: Default invitation time printed on cards.

hostMessage.description: Opening editorial note from the host.

heroImageUrl.description: Optional custom URL for the primary hero invitation photo.

secondaryImageUrl.description: Optional custom URL for the secondary gallery photo.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last admin update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who last updated settings.

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: Personalized yearbook invitation card created by an admin with custom guest name, invitation time, and direct guest RSVP state.

guestName.description: Custom display name of the invited guest.

salutation.description: Formal or warm greeting prefix printed before the guest name.

groupLabel.description: Guest category such as Ban be, Thay Co, Dong nghiep, Gia dinh.

customTime.description: Custom invitation time printed on this guest's card.

customVenue.description: Optional venue override for this guest.

personalNote.description: Personal invitation message written by the admin for this guest.

companionCount.description: Number of additional companions accompanying the guest (0 to 5).

guestMessage.description: Wishes or confirmation note submitted by the guest.

respondedAt.description: Server timestamp when the guest confirmed attendance, or null.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the invitation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who created the invitation.

PublicRsvp.title: PublicRsvp
PublicRsvp.description: Direct RSVP submission from a general visitor arriving without a personalized invitation link.

guestName.description: Full name entered by the confirming guest.

groupLabel.description: Relationship or group (Ban be, Dong nghiep, Thay Co, Nguoi than).

guestMessage.description: Yearbook wish or note left by the guest.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted co-admin record authorized to manage invitations and event settings.

/eventSettings/{settingId}.description: Stores the global yearbook ceremony settings at /eventSettings/main.

/invitations/{inviteId}.description: Stores personalized guest invitations created by admin and confirmed directly by guests.

/publicRsvps/{rsvpId}.description: Stores direct RSVPs submitted from the general landing page.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores additional authorized admin UIDs managed by the primary owner.
